plain_english_policy: This bill creates a state income tax credit to encourage small businesses (those with 50 or fewer employees) to hire new workers. To qualify, the business must create full-time jobs paying at least $10 per hour and show a net increase in its Alabama workforce compared to the previous year. The credit is worth up to $1,000 for each eligible employee after they complete one year of employment. This incentive aims to foster job growth across Alabama by making hiring new staff financially beneficial for qualifying employers.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce a policy direction that incentivizes small business expansion and full-time job creation in Alabama through direct tax relief, specifically targeting positions paying $10/hour or more. It shifts economic development strategy toward rewarding net new hiring rather than just total employment numbers.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a policy of incentivizing job creation through tax credits for small businesses that hire full-time employees earning $10/hour or more.
evidence_quotes: "To provide an incentive for job creation in Alabama;"
"The Legislature intends to foster an optimal environment for job growth throughout the state."

"An Alabama income and financial institution excise tax credit is hereby established for small businesses that create new jobs paying more than ten dollars ($10) per hour. The credit shall equal one thousand dollars ($1,000)..."
